tour_title: 14 Days 13 Nights - Tailor-made for VIP Guests
lede: This 14-day grand luxury journey is tailored perfectly to capture the essence of Vietnam from North to South.
route_txt: Hanoi – Ninh Binh – Halong Bay – Hoi An – Da Nang – Hue – Da Nang – Ho Chi Minh City – Departure
seller_name: Vietnam Safar – Discovery Asia Travel Group
overview_h2: Prepared for: VIP Family — 14 Days 13 Nights - Tailor-made for VIP Guests
overview_p: A premium and slow-paced journey designed for luxury family travelers, showcasing the cultural depth of Hanoi, the cinematic landscapes of Ha Long Bay, the heritage of Hoi An, the beach relaxation in Da Nang, and the dynamic vibe of Ho Chi Minh City.
overview_paras: This 14-day grand luxury journey is tailored perfectly to capture the essence of Vietnam from North to South.

The itinerary is designed to provide a perfect balance of guided exploration and leisure time, staying in the country's most iconic luxury properties such as The Reverie Saigon and Hyatt Regency Danang.

itinerary_p: Your private 14D13N journey — 14 days, carefully crafted.

itinerary.title: Day 1 — Hanoi
description: Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, guests are warmly received by our dedicated concierge team and escorted via luxury private transfer to the Peridot Grand Luxury Boutique Hotel. The evening features a curated welcome dinner, offering a sophisticated introduction to Northern Vietnamese culinary traditions in a refined setting.

itinerary.title: Day 2 — Hanoi
description: The day is devoted to a comprehensive exploration of Hanoi’s rich heritage. Accompanied by a private historian guide, the itinerary includes exclusive visits to the city's most significant cultural landmarks. The pace is deliberately unhurried, ensuring an immersive and private experience away from standard tourist routes.

itinerary.title: Day 3 — Ninh Binh
description: Guests depart Hanoi for the spectacular landscapes of Ninh Binh. The program features a private sampan excursion through the tranquil waterways and majestic limestone karsts of Trang An. This meticulously arranged day trip offers a profound connection with Vietnam's natural beauty with the utmost privacy.

itinerary.title: Day 4 — Halong Bay
description: A private transfer conveys guests to the coastal city of Ha Long to board the distinguished Celina Of The Sea Cruise. After checking into the Executive Balcony suite, the afternoon is spent cruising through the UNESCO World Heritage seascape. As evening approaches, the crew will execute a seamlessly orchestrated birthday celebration, complete with...

itinerary.title: Day 5 — Hoi An
description: Following a leisurely morning on the cruise, guests disembark and are transferred for a short domestic flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, a private chauffeur provides a seamless transfer to the Anantara Hoi An Resort. The afternoon includes a premium bespoke tailoring consultation, a hallmark experience of this historic trading port.

itinerary.title: Day 6 — Hoi An
description: A full-day guided exploration of the beautifully preserved Hoi An Ancient Town. The private tour delves into the architectural marvels and rich trading history of the area. The evening concludes with a refined dining experience, showcasing the intricate flavors of Central Vietnamese cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 7 — Hoi An
description: The morning features a specialized photography tour, designed to capture professional portraits of the family against the iconic, lantern-lit backdrop of Hoi An. The afternoon is reserved for leisure, allowing guests to fully enjoy the premium amenities and tranquil environment of the Anantara Resort.

itinerary.title: Day 8 — Da Nang
description: The journey continues with a transfer to the coastal city of Da Nang, coupled with a curated half-day city tour highlighting local cultural landmarks. Guests will then check into a spectacular 3-Bedroom Beach Front Pool Villa at the Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa, providing an unparalleled standard of privacy and comfort.

itinerary.title: Day 9 — Da Nang
description: A premium excursion to the elevated resort of Ba Na Hills. The itinerary includes priority access to the cable car system and a guided walk across the architectural masterpiece, the Golden Bridge. Guests will explore the French Village before returning to the sanctuary of their beachfront villa.
activities: Private transfer, Ba Na Hills ticket.

itinerary.title: Day 10 — Hue
description: A full-day excursion to the former imperial capital of Hue. The privately guided itinerary encompasses the majestic Imperial Citadel and the opulent royal mausoleums, offering an in-depth perspective on Vietnam's regal history and architectural grandeur under the Nguyen Dynasty.

itinerary.title: Day 11 — Da Nang
description: A day allocated entirely for leisure at the beachfront villa, allowing guests to relax by their private pool or partake in the resort's luxury wellness offerings. The evening is highlighted by a second, meticulously planned birthday celebration—an exclusive dining experience orchestrated by the resort’s culinary team within the privacy of the...

itinerary.title: Day 12 — Ho Chi Minh City
description: Following a seamless domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh City, guests embark on a privately guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, gaining insight into this remarkable underground network. The day concludes with check-in at The Reverie Saigon, an establishment renowned for its opulent Italian design and world-class service.

itinerary.title: Day 13 — Ho Chi Minh City
description: An immersive full-day journey into the Mekong Delta. Traveling aboard a private luxury river vessel, guests observe the vibrant riverine culture and visit local artisanal workshops. This carefully curated excursion provides a sophisticated and comfortable approach to exploring one of Vietnam's most vital agricultural regions.

itinerary.title: Day 14 — Departure
description: The final morning is at the guests' leisure to enjoy the premium facilities of The Reverie Saigon. At the appropriate time, a private chauffeur will provide a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the departing flight, concluding a flawlessly executed luxury journey.

programOverview.heading: PROGRAM OVERVIEW
paragraphs: This 14-day grand luxury journey is tailored perfectly to capture the essence of Vietnam from North to South.

The itinerary is designed to provide a perfect balance of guided exploration and leisure time, staying in the country's most iconic luxury properties such as The Reverie Saigon and Hyatt Regency Danang.

itinerary.summary: Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, guests are warmly received by our dedicated concierge team and escorted via luxury private transfer to the Peridot Grand Luxury Boutique Hotel. The evening features a curated welcome dinner, offering a sophisticated introduction to Northern Vietnamese culinary traditions in a refined setting.

The day is devoted to a comprehensive exploration of Hanoi’s rich heritage. Accompanied by a private historian guide, the itinerary includes exclusive visits to the city's most significant cultural landmarks. The pace is deliberately unhurried, ensuring an immersive and private experience away from standard tourist routes.

Guests depart Hanoi for the spectacular landscapes of Ninh Binh. The program features a private sampan excursion through the tranquil waterways and majestic limestone karsts of Trang An. This meticulously arranged day trip offers a profound connection with Vietnam's natural beauty with the utmost privacy.

A private transfer conveys guests to the coastal city of Ha Long to board the distinguished Celina Of The Sea Cruise. After checking into the Executive Balcony suite, the afternoon is spent cruising through the UNESCO World Heritage seascape. As evening approaches, the crew will execute a seamlessly orchestrated birthday celebration, complete with a bespoke private dinner arrangement.

Following a leisurely morning on the cruise, guests disembark and are transferred for a short domestic flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, a private chauffeur provides a seamless transfer to the Anantara Hoi An Resort. The afternoon includes a premium bespoke tailoring consultation, a hallmark experience of this historic trading port.

A full-day guided exploration of the beautifully preserved Hoi An Ancient Town. The private tour delves into the architectural marvels and rich trading history of the area. The evening concludes with a refined dining experience, showcasing the intricate flavors of Central Vietnamese cuisine.

The morning features a specialized photography tour, designed to capture professional portraits of the family against the iconic, lantern-lit backdrop of Hoi An. The afternoon is reserved for leisure, allowing guests to fully enjoy the premium amenities and tranquil environment of the Anantara Resort.

The journey continues with a transfer to the coastal city of Da Nang, coupled with a curated half-day city tour highlighting local cultural landmarks. Guests will then check into a spectacular 3-Bedroom Beach Front Pool Villa at the Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa, providing an unparalleled standard of privacy and comfort.

A premium excursion to the elevated resort of Ba Na Hills. The itinerary includes priority access to the cable car system and a guided walk across the architectural masterpiece, the Golden Bridge. Guests will explore the French Village before returning to the sanctuary of their beachfront villa.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private transfer, Ba Na Hills ticket.

itinerary.summary: A full-day excursion to the former imperial capital of Hue. The privately guided itinerary encompasses the majestic Imperial Citadel and the opulent royal mausoleums, offering an in-depth perspective on Vietnam's regal history and architectural grandeur under the Nguyen Dynasty.

A day allocated entirely for leisure at the beachfront villa, allowing guests to relax by their private pool or partake in the resort's luxury wellness offerings. The evening is highlighted by a second, meticulously planned birthday celebration—an exclusive dining experience orchestrated by the resort’s culinary team within the privacy of the villa.

Following a seamless domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh City, guests embark on a privately guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, gaining insight into this remarkable underground network. The day concludes with check-in at The Reverie Saigon, an establishment renowned for its opulent Italian design and world-class service.

An immersive full-day journey into the Mekong Delta. Traveling aboard a private luxury river vessel, guests observe the vibrant riverine culture and visit local artisanal workshops. This carefully curated excursion provides a sophisticated and comfortable approach to exploring one of Vietnam's most vital agricultural regions.

The final morning is at the guests' leisure to enjoy the premium facilities of The Reverie Saigon. At the appropriate time, a private chauffeur will provide a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the departing flight, concluding a flawlessly executed luxury journey.

                Every final detail can be refined around your preferred pace, room choices and family priorities.

edited_fields.day_desc_11_0: A day allocated entirely for leisure at the beachfront villa, allowing guests to relax by their private pool or partake in the resort's luxury wellness offerings. The evening is highlighted by a second, meticulously planned birthday celebration—an exclusive dining experience orchestrated by the resort’s culinary team within the privacy of the...
edited_fields.day_desc_12_0: Following a seamless domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh City, guests embark on a privately guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, gaining insight into this remarkable underground network. The day concludes with check-in at The Reverie Saigon, an establishment renowned for its opulent Italian design and world-class service.
edited_fields.day_desc_13_0: An immersive full-day journey into the Mekong Delta. Traveling aboard a private luxury river vessel, guests observe the vibrant riverine culture and visit local artisanal workshops. This carefully curated excursion provides a sophisticated and comfortable approach to exploring one of Vietnam's most vital agricultural regions.
edited_fields.day_desc_14_0: The final morning is at the guests' leisure to enjoy the premium facilities of The Reverie Saigon. At the appropriate time, a private chauffeur will provide a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the departing flight, concluding a flawlessly executed luxury journey.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_1: Peridot Grand Luxury Boutique Hotel offers an oasis of tranquility in the heart of Hanoi's Old Quarter, blending chic design with Vietnamese hospitality.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_2: Celina Of The Sea Cruise provides a luxurious and unforgettable journey through the majestic limestone karsts and emerald waters of Ha Long Bay.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_3: Anantara Hoi An Resort is a boutique retreat on the banks of the Thu Bon River, offering elegant French colonial architecture and seamless access to the historic old town.
edited_fields.hotel_name_4: Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa
edited_fields.hotel_intro_4: Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa is a luxury beachfront resort offering stunning ocean views, expansive pools, and world-class dining on the pristine Non Nuoc Beach.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_5: The Reverie Saigon is an ultra-luxury hotel in Ho Chi Minh City, showcasing spectacular Italian design, opulent interiors, and unparalleled views of the Saigon River.
